description.label: Description
description.value:
You lower the temperature of your body. You are completely immune to damage from non-magical cold, including the @Compendium[wfrp4e-core.items.uqGxFOEqeurwkAO3]{Breath} attacks of monsters, and ignore any @Condition[Stunned] Conditions you receive. You receive the @Compendium[wfrp4e-core.items.Bvd2aZ0gQUXHfCTh]{Ward (9+)} Creature Trait against magical cold attacks including spells from the Lore of Ice.

 

Lore : The flows of Ice Magic vary in strength. By Kislev’s sites of power, along her leylines, in freezing climates and in the depths of winter, Ice Magic is very strong, granting you a +10 to all Channelling and Language (Magick) Tests when casting the Lore of Ice. But in warmer climes, it is far weaker and wanes the closer to the equator and the further from the North one travels. When casting in warmer climates, such as in most of the Empire, it counts as if casting next to a Corrupting Influence, causing a Minor Miscast Table on a unit’s roll of an 8. If you already have a Minor Miscast Table, the Miscast becomes a Major Miscast Table. In hotter climates, such as in a desert or jungle, you receive a permanent Fatigued Condition until you relocate to a cooler climate. You may spend a Resolve point to mitigate this Fatigue Condition for one round.
